text: DeepCanary 是面向 DSH WebUI 和 Windows 桌面端的任务提醒与收件箱插件。它接入 DSH 会话和运行状态，在侧边栏提供可移动、可调整大小的面板，并将需要回答或审批、异常状态及常规任务更新整理为待处理、稍后和动态项目。用户可查看提醒详情、返回对应会话、确认处理、延后提醒或调整通知级别、静默时段与中断频率；也可通过工具读取状态和收件箱、解释规则或预览策略结果。插件使用本地规则评估会话信号，并在浏览器支持时发送通知。需要兼容的 DSH 版本；不要求额外 API 密钥。

DeepCanary adds a task inbox to DSH WebUI and Windows Desktop. Its sidebar groups alerts as pending, snoozed, or activity. Users can reopen sessions, acknowledge or snooze items, and set quiet hours. DSH tools expose status and policy explanations. It requires a compatible DSH host.
想在 DSH 里集中查看需要我回答或审批的任务。
DSH 任务失败或卡住时，能不能提醒我去检查？
我想把普通完成和紧急待办分开显示。
帮我稍后再提醒某个任务，不要现在打断我。
想给 DSH 的通知设置静默时段和每小时打扰上限。
我需要从提醒直接回到对应的 DSH 会话。
有没有面板能查看任务状态并确认提醒已经处理？
让 DSH 把上下文压缩、子任务压力等状态汇总到收件箱。
I want one inbox for DSH tasks waiting for my answer or approval.
Can DSH alert me when a task stalls or fails?
Let me snooze a task reminder and return to its session later.
I need quiet hours and a limit on how often DSH interrupts me.
DeepCanary 的功能「任务注意力收件箱」：按待处理、稍后和动态整理会话提醒，并显示级别、原因与状态。用户从侧边栏打开面板、选择项目查看详情。
DeepCanary 的功能「本地规则提醒」：根据等待审批或回答、主机中断、工具连续失败、进展停滞、子任务和上下文状态形成分级判定，再应用通知偏好。
DeepCanary 的功能「处理与延后提醒」：用户可确认、稍后提醒或静音收件箱项目；延后时长有界，并由工具或面板操作触发。
DeepCanary 的功能「通知偏好」：设置最低提醒级别、C2 每小时中断预算、静默时段、去重与事件合并窗口。通过 DSH 插件配置及面板设置调整。
DeepCanary 的功能「状态与策略工具」：向 DSH 注册工具以读取插件状态和收件箱、解释提醒判定，并对结构化信号进行只读策略预览。
DeepCanary 将收件箱提醒元数据和状态保存在 DSH 配置数据目录；默认状态目录按 profile/instance 隔离。

DeepCanary

dsh-deepcanary README · Introduction：

简体中文 · Documentation · Changelog · Releases

DeepCanary groups task updates in **Pending**, **Snoozed**, and **Activity**. It reminds you when DSH needs an answer or approval, keeps routine completions in Activity, and returns you to the corresponding session.

dsh-deepcanary README · Install：DeepCanary **0.1.9-rc.1** requires DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` or `0.2.2-alpha.3` and later. Check the [Node.js requirements for WebUI](#compatibility) before installing. Windows Desktop includes its own runtime. [Install DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#readme).

dsh-deepcanary README · Windows Desktop：1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**.
2. Enter `dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1` under **Package name or address** and choose **Install**.
3. Follow any restart prompt, then open **DeepCanary** from the left sidebar.

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：Stop the running DSH WebUI server. Run these commands in your terminal.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1 --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
dsh web
```

Open **DeepCanary** from the sidebar once WebUI starts.

<details>
<summary>Use a custom DSH data directory or profile</summary>

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：If you start DSH with another profile, replace `web` in both commands with that name. If your launch command sets `DSH_HOME`, set it to the same directory in your terminal before installing, updating, or removing the plugin.

PowerShell

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "<existing DSH data directory>"
```

Bash or Zsh

```sh
export DSH_HOME="<existing DSH data directory>"
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>Install from a downloaded package</summary>

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：Download the tgz and `SHA256SUMS` from the [GitHub release](https://github.com/Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepcanary/releases/tag/v0.1.9-rc.1). Run one of these commands from the download directory and compare the result with the package entry in `SHA256SUMS`.

```powershell
Get-FileHash ./dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz -Algorithm SHA256
```

```sh
shasum -a 256 ./dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz
```

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：For WebUI, stop the server and run the commands below from the download directory. The package manager may still download dependencies from npm.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
dsh web
```

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：For Windows Desktop, open DSH once to initialize its profile, then choose **Application → Quit**. Open PowerShell in `resources/runtime/cli/bin` under the application directory. If you use a custom `DSH_HOME`, set it as shown above. Replace the placeholder with the full path to the downloaded package, run the command, and reopen DSH.

```powershell
.\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add "<full path to dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz>" --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

</details>

dsh-deepcanary README · Use：| View | What you'll find |
| --- | --- |
| **Pending** | Questions, approvals, and task updates that need attention |
| **Snoozed** | Reminders scheduled for later |
| **Activity** | Routine completions, context compaction, and tasks you stopped |

Select a reminder to see its details. Use the DSH button to open the session and reply or approve there. Choose **More actions → Acknowledge** to clear the reminder from Pending, or **Snooze** to schedule it for later.

dsh-deepcanary README · Use：Drag the title bar to move the panel and drag any edge or corner to resize it. Drag the divider to adjust the list width. The **Layout** menu lets you dock, expand, restore, or reset the panel. DeepCanary remembers the layout on this device. In narrow windows, the list keeps its scroll position when you return from a reminder.

dsh-deepcanary README · Use：For keyboard control, choose move or resize from **Layout**. Use the arrow keys to adjust the panel, hold Shift for larger steps, press Enter to confirm, or press Escape to cancel.

dsh-deepcanary README · Notifications：Open **Alert settings** from the inbox. Set the minimum alert level, quiet hours, and the hourly limit for C2 interruptions. C3 reminders can still appear during quiet hours and after the C2 limit is reached.

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **C3** | DSH is waiting for an answer or approval before it can continue |
| **C2** | An error or unusual task state needs checking |
| **C1** | A routine update is available in Activity |

dsh-deepcanary README · Notifications：In WebUI, allow notifications for your DSH site and leave a DSH tab open. In Windows, allow notifications from your browser or DeepSeek Harness. The desktop app can receive notifications while minimized or hidden if it is still running.

Click a notification to return to the reminder and session. Respond to questions and approvals in DSH to continue the task.

dsh-deepcanary README · Update or remove：To replace an earlier version on Windows Desktop, uninstall DeepCanary from **Plugins**, then add `dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1` in the same DSH app. Follow any restart prompts. To remove the plugin, stop after uninstalling.

For WebUI, stop the server and repeat the [installation commands](#webui). Use the same DSH data directory and profile to keep your settings and reminders.

dsh-deepcanary README · Update or remove：To remove DeepCanary from WebUI, stop the server, run the following command, then restart WebUI. Replace `web` if you use another profile.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-deepcanary
```

dsh-deepcanary README · Compatibility：| Tested DSH version | Platforms | Node.js for WebUI |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.5` | WebUI and Windows Desktop | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| `0.2.2-alpha.3` | WebUI and Windows Desktop | `>=24.9.0` |

Later DSH versions can install this package. Check the Node.js requirement for your DSH version. [Compatibility details](docs/compatibility.md).

dsh-deepcanary README · Troubleshooting：| Problem | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| DeepCanary is missing | Check **Plugins** in the DSH app you use. For WebUI, confirm the data directory and profile match your launch command. Restart if prompted. |
| DSH installs an older version | Enter `dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1` and use the official npm registry, `https://registry.npmjs.org/`. |
| Installation is rejected | Check the DSH and Node.js versions in [Compatibility](#compatibility). |
| No system banner appears | Check that DSH is running, then check browser permission, Windows Do Not Disturb, and [alert settings](#notifications). |
| A session cannot be opened | Check whether the session still appears in your current DSH app. You can still read the reminder in the inbox. |
| The panel is hard to reach | Select **Layout → Reset layout**. |
| Reminder state cannot be saved | Click **Refresh status** in the inbox to retry. If it fails again, check that the account running DSH can write to its profile directory. |

dsh-deepcanary README · Troubleshooting：For ordinary bugs, include your DSH and DeepCanary versions, operating system, and steps to reproduce. Remove private content before posting. [Report an issue](https://github.com/Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepcanary/issues).

dsh-deepcanary README · Security and privacy：DeepCanary saves reminder metadata in your DSH data directory and uses local rules to decide when to notify you. Read about the files it saves and how notifications use them. [Data and privacy](docs/security.md).

Use the private reporting channel for vulnerabilities. [Security policy](SECURITY.md).

DeepCanary 将任务变化归入**待处理**、**稍后**和**动态**。DSH 需要你回答或审批时发出提醒，普通完成进入动态，点击后可返回对应会话。

dsh-deepcanary README · 安装：DeepCanary **0.1.9-rc.1** 支持 DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` 以及 `0.2.2-alpha.3` 和后续版本。使用 WebUI 前，请查看[对应的 Node.js 要求](#兼容性)。Windows 桌面版自带运行时。参见 [DeepSeek Harness 安装说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#readme)。

dsh-deepcanary README · Windows 桌面版：1. 打开**插件 → 添加插件 → 安装第三方插件**。
2. 在**包名或地址**中输入 `dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1`，点击**安装**。
3. 如有提示，重启 DSH，然后从左侧边栏打开 **DeepCanary**。

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：停止正在运行的 DSH WebUI 服务，在终端执行以下命令。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1 --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
dsh web
```

启动 WebUI 后，从侧边栏打开 **DeepCanary**。

<details>
<summary>使用自定义 DSH 数据目录或配置名称</summary>

如果平时使用其他配置，将两条命令中的 `web` 换成该配置的名称。如果启动 DSH 时设置了 `DSH_HOME`，安装、更新或卸载前，先在当前终端将它设为同一个目录。

PowerShell

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "<现有 DSH 数据目录>"
```

Bash 或 Zsh

```sh
export DSH_HOME="<现有 DSH 数据目录>"
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>使用下载的安装包</summary>

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：从 [GitHub 发布页](https://github.com/Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepcanary/releases/tag/v0.1.9-rc.1)下载 tgz 和 `SHA256SUMS`。在下载目录中运行以下任一命令，将结果与 `SHA256SUMS` 中对应的值比较。

```powershell
Get-FileHash ./dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz -Algorithm SHA256
```

```sh
shasum -a 256 ./dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz
```

安装到 WebUI 时，先停止服务，再在下载目录中运行以下命令。包管理器可能仍需从 npm 下载依赖。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
dsh web
```

dsh-deepcanary README · WebUI：安装到 Windows 桌面版时，先打开一次 DSH 以初始化配置，再选择**应用 → 退出**。在应用目录下的 `resources/runtime/cli/bin` 中打开 PowerShell。使用自定义 `DSH_HOME` 时，先按上文设置。将占位内容换成下载包的完整路径，执行命令后重新打开 DSH。

```powershell
.\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add "<dsh-deepcanary-0.1.9-rc.1.tgz 的完整路径>" --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

</details>

dsh-deepcanary README · 使用：| 分类 | 显示内容 |
| --- | --- |
| **待处理** | 等待回答、等待审批及其他需要关注的任务更新 |
| **稍后** | 已安排稍后提醒的事项 |
| **动态** | 普通完成、上下文压缩，以及你主动停止的任务 |

选择一条提醒查看详情，点击详情里的 DSH 按钮进入会话，在那里回答问题或处理审批。选择**更多操作 → 已处理**可将提醒移出待处理，选择**稍后提醒**可安排下一次提醒。

拖动标题栏可移动面板，拖动边缘或角落可调整大小，拖动分隔条可调整列表宽度。**布局**菜单提供停靠、展开、恢复和重置。DeepCanary 会在当前设备记住布局。窗口较窄时，从详情返回列表会回到之前的滚动位置。

需要用键盘调整时，从**布局**菜单选择移动或调整大小。用方向键调整，按住 Shift 加大步长，按 Enter 确认，按 Esc 取消。

dsh-deepcanary README · 通知：从收件箱打开**提醒设置**，可以选择最低提醒级别、设置静默时段，并限制每小时 C2 打断次数。静默时段或 C2 打断次数达到上限时，C3 仍可提醒。

| 等级 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| **C3** | DSH 正等待回答或审批，处理后才能继续 |
| **C2** | 任务出现错误或异常状态，需要检查 |
| **C1** | 有常规更新可在动态中查看 |

使用 WebUI 时，允许 DSH 站点发送通知，并保留一个 DSH 页面。Windows 用户还需在系统设置中允许浏览器或 DeepSeek Harness 发送通知。桌面应用持续运行时，窗口最小化或隐藏后仍可收到提醒。

点击系统通知可返回对应提醒和会话。在 DSH 中回答问题或完成审批，即可继续任务。

dsh-deepcanary README · 更新或卸载：Windows 桌面版用户可在**插件**中卸载旧版，再在同一个 DSH 应用中添加 `dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1`。如有提示，按提示重启。只想移除插件时，完成卸载即可。

WebUI 用户先停止服务，再执行上面的[安装命令](#webui)。沿用原来的 DSH 数据目录和配置名称，以保留设置与提醒。

从 WebUI 移除 DeepCanary 时，先停止服务，再运行以下命令并重启 WebUI。使用其他配置时，将 `web` 换成该配置的名称。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-deepcanary
```

dsh-deepcanary README · 兼容性：| 已测试的 DSH 版本 | 平台 | WebUI 的 Node.js 要求 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.5` | WebUI 和 Windows 桌面版 | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| `0.2.2-alpha.3` | WebUI 和 Windows 桌面版 | `>=24.9.0` |

后续 DSH 版本可以安装此包，Node.js 要求请查阅所用 DSH 版本的说明。参见[兼容性详情](docs/compatibility.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-deepcanary README · 常见问题：| 问题 | 检查方法 |
| --- | --- |
| 找不到 DeepCanary | 在当前使用的 DSH 应用中打开**插件**。使用 WebUI 时，核对数据目录和配置名称是否与启动命令一致。如有提示，先重启。 |
| DSH 安装了旧版本 | 输入完整的 `dsh-deepcanary@0.1.9-rc.1`，并使用 npm 官方源 `https://registry.npmjs.org/`。 |
| 安装被拒绝 | 按[兼容性](#兼容性)核对 DSH 和 Node.js 版本。 |
| 没有系统横幅 | 确认 DSH 仍在运行，再检查浏览器权限、Windows“勿扰”和[提醒设置](#通知)。 |
| 无法返回会话 | 确认该会话仍列在当前 DSH 应用中。你仍可以在收件箱查看提醒。 |
| 面板位置或大小不合适 | 选择**布局 → 重置布局**。 |
| 提醒状态保存失败 | 点击收件箱的**刷新状态**重试。如果仍然失败，检查运行 DSH 的账户是否能写入对应的配置目录。 |
dsh-deepcanary README · 常见问题：报告普通问题时，请附上 DSH 与 DeepCanary 版本、操作系统及复现步骤，提交前移除私密内容。[报告问题](https://github.com/Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepcanary/issues)。

dsh-deepcanary README · 安全与隐私：DeepCanary 在 DSH 数据目录中保存提醒元数据，并使用本地规则决定何时提醒。具体保存的文件与通知行为见[数据与隐私](docs/security.zh-CN.md)。

请通过私密渠道报告漏洞。参见[安全政策](SECURITY.zh-CN.md)。
